close_reason: Keep lenient (Option A). pkix-revocation::CrlChecker::new_with_signer_discovery's anchor-reachability gate stays structural-only — the reaches_self_signed walk treats any self-issued cert (subject == issuer) as a terminator without verifying the self-signature or matching against a TrustAnchor slice. Strict semantics (full chain verification, anchor DN matching) are deferred to higher-layer composers (pkix-chain), consistent with AGENTS.md non-negotiable #2 (one-way dependency: chain -> revocation -> path) and the framework-not-policy stance. This matches the Option A path that PKIX-cqwt explicitly chose. A future stricter mode can be added as an additional constructor variant if a consumer surfaces.
description:
Follow-up to PKIX-cqwt.

The CrlChecker::new_with_signer_discovery anchor-reachability gate (reaches_self_signed in signer_discovery.rs) treats any *self-issued* cert (subject == issuer) as an anchor terminator. This includes:

1. Real self-signed root CAs.
2. Self-issued key-rollover bridge certs (PKITS §4.5 case: BasicSelfIssuedOldKeyNewWithOldCACert is self-issued but signed by a different key from the bridge subject's own).

Option A (chosen) explicitly defers full signature verification of the signer's chain to higher-layer composers (pkix-chain). The current structural-only walk accepts both cases as 'reached an anchor.'

This is the intended behavior under Option A but worth surfacing as a separate bead because:
- A future caller might assume reaches_self_signed === 'this cert verifies back to a TA' (it does not).
- If we ever want stricter semantics in pkix-revocation, we would either (a) require the caller to also pass a TrustAnchor slice and check that the terminating self-issued cert's subject matches an anchor DN, or (b) actually verify the self-signature.

Acceptance:
- Decide stance: keep lenient (close as won't-fix) OR tighten by passing trust anchors into new_with_signer_discovery.
- If tightening, add a TrustAnchor parameter and check the terminating cert's subject DN matches an anchor.

Refs:
- pkix-revocation/src/signer_discovery.rs::reaches_self_signed
- PKIX-cqwt notes ratifying Option A
- AGENTS.md non-negotiable #2
title: pkix-revocation: stricter signer-chain anchor check in discovery
